title: Francis Bacon: Study from the Human Body Poster

description.main: This oversize poster reproduces Study from the Human Body (1986) by Francis Bacon, made for the 2026 exhibition Francis Bacon at Gagosian's rue de Castiglione gallery in Paris. The painting sets a solitary, contorted figure against a sharp yellow ground, with a red arrow pointing toward the figure's confinement.
description.extended:
This oversize poster reproduces Study from the Human Body (1986), one of three late paintings by Francis Bacon shown in the exhibition Francis Bacon at Gagosian's rue de Castiglione gallery in Paris.

The exhibition, on view April 11-May 30, 2026, brought together three major canvases from Bacon's final period and reaffirmed his ties to Paris, where he kept a studio from 1975 to 1987. In the painting, a solitary, contorted figure crouches against a sharp yellow ground while a red arrow points toward its confinement; the yellow recalls a group of paintings Bacon made in 1969, among them a triptych of Lucian Freud.

Bacon (1909-1992) spent his career returning to the human figure, painting distorted bodies and faces charged with psychological intensity. This poster, produced in 2026, carries the imagery of one of his last major statements on that subject.
description.artist_bio: Francis Bacon (1909-1992), born in Dublin, was among the most significant figurative painters of the twentieth century. He returned throughout his career to the human figure, painting distorted bodies and faces set against intense fields of color, exploring existential alienation and psychological intensity; he maintained a studio in Paris from 1975 to 1987.
description.exhibition_context: Francis Bacon at Gagosian's rue de Castiglione gallery in Paris (April 11-May 30, 2026) brought together three major paintings from the artist's final period, works that embody the intensity of his late output while reaffirming his link to the city.

notes: Oversize poster (60 x 40 in / 152.4 x 101.6 cm), larger than the standard Gagosian poster format. Produced 2026 for the exhibition Francis Bacon at Gagosian, rue de Castiglione, Paris (April 11-May 30, 2026), which brought together three major late paintings. Bacon died in 1992; described here in the past tense. Reproduces Study from the Human Body (1986), oil, pastel, aerosol paint and dry transfer lettering on canvas, 78 x 58 inches, The Estate of Francis Bacon.
